text:
maria: Heads-up: we've detected anomalous SignBlob activity tied to the model-registry signing key (mreg-signing-prod). Failures and unexpected sign requests started ~08:42 UTC. Suspect compromised CI or leaked creds.

ops-bot: [ALERT] signblob-unexpected-usage service=model-registry rate=120/min triggered at 2026-11-02T08:42:10Z.

maria: Immediate plan: 1) create new KMS key mreg-signing-prod-v4, 2) switch registry to v4 in staging and smoke, 3) set verifier to soft-reject old-key signatures then hard-reject, 4) re-sign deployed artifacts from high->low priority.

ben: I'll run the detection query now to enumerate artifacts and principals.

claire: Detection query for ops:
```
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"SignBlob\" AND resource.labels.project_id=\"redwood-prod\" AND protoPayload.request.serviceAccountEmail:\"*mreg-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" AND timestamp>\"2026-11-02T08:00:00Z\"" --limit 500
```

ben: Found 4 external runners calling SignBlob at 08:37-08:41 UTC. Two are partner CI, one is internal stale runner, one unknown. Disabling unknown runner and rotating tokens.

dave: I'll prepare the key rotation steps and ETA. Staging rotate + canary = 30m, full rotate + re-sign prioritized artifacts = ~5-7h.

maria: Communications: legal/CS - prepare a short customer advisory for Dedicated customers with auto-sync enabled. Private customers get advisory but we won't force remote rotation.

legal: Drafting notice. Will include timeline, impact, and contact for provenance/WORM concerns.

ops-bot: Canaries: verifier v6.0.1-canary -> 10% deployed at 2026-11-02T09:05:00Z. Monitoring attestation-errors and latency.

claire: Re-signing plan: re-sign top 30 deployed artifacts first. We'll run parallel workers and mark artifacts as re-attested with v4. Postback to registry webhook to notify runtime.

ben: Started re-sign job: 0/30 done. Posting progress.

dave: Note to runtime teams: expect transient attestation mismatches during rollout; please configure SDKs to fallback to accept new attestation when available, or retry fetch. DevEx will push a minor SDK warning soon.

cs: Preparing CS notes and FAQ. Target send within 90 minutes to affected Dedicated accounts.

maria: Ops: snapshot and isolate the unknown runner, handoff to SecOps for forensics. Rotate any exposed service-account keys immediately.

ops-bot: Post-rotation detection run shows no further SignBlob calls from unknown principals after 09:15 UTC.

ben: Progress update: 20/30 artifacts re-signed, 0 failures. Re-sign backlog queued.

maria: Final: old key access will be revoked and scheduled for destruction after 7-day quarantine. Incident INC-2026-MREG-11 created for postmortem. Thank you everyone. Close this thread when customer emails are sent and re-sign backlog completes. :lock:
